subject.title: [Bug]: Isolated cron agentTurn fails with 'setup timed out before runner start' — all fallback models exhausted on 2026.5.12

question: Should OpenClaw accept the bounded longer isolated-cron setup watchdog proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96219 for this pre-runner timeout class?
rationale: Current source and release evidence show the 60s ceiling still exists, while the candidate fix trades fewer false setup timeouts for longer cron slot occupancy when setup is truly stuck.

options.title: Land bounded derived watchdog
options.body: Accept the open PR's 60s floor, half-job-timeout derivation, and 10-minute cap as the canonical policy for this issue.

options.title: Tighten before merge
options.body: Ask for a lower cap or extra live operational proof before changing default cron setup timing.

options.title: Require configurability
options.body: Reject a default-only behavior change and require an operator-tunable watchdog surface with config and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Land bounded derived watchdog
recommendation.body: Accept the open PR's 60s floor, half-job-timeout derivation, and 10-minute cap as the canonical policy for this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main and release-line ownership make this the best available owner for accepting the cron watchdog policy tradeoff.
